briefs: Asian stocks plunge as the AI sell-off spreads: KOSPI -6.16%, Nikkei -2.78%; the Dow closes above 50,000 for the first time.
Sudan: RSF drone strikes kill 19 civilians and wound 20 in two cities, rights lawyers say.
Colombia frees every hostage in a Cartagena supermarket siege; one captor is killed.
Pope Leo XIV laments the COP31 climate talks ending with no deal.
Senegal is restored as Africa Cup champions as the sports court rules in its favour.
footer: THE DAILY GLOBE  |  Wednesday, 25 November 2026  |  Sources: Just Security, AP, Reuters, BBC, Zacks

lead.body: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says two tankers hit naval mines and caught fire in the strait. Brent slides as shipping fears grow.
lead.headline: Two tankers ablaze after mine strikes in the Strait of Hormuz

stories.body: Houthi forces say they hit the Ras Tanura refinery, causing fires, a day after a Riyadh tower strike injured 11.
stories.headline: Houthis strike Saudi Arabia's biggest oil refinery

stories.body: Syzran and Kuibyshev refineries are hit overnight; one person is killed and 145 Ukrainian drones are downed.
stories.headline: Ukrainian drones set two Russian refineries ablaze

stories.body: A Brooklyn jury convicts on bank fraud, wire fraud, sanctions and trade-secret theft; it acquits on racketeering.
stories.headline: Huawei guilty on 10 of 12 counts in US trial

stories.body: Mohammad Abuelouf, his wife and two children are killed; 1,679 deaths are recorded since the October ceasefire.
stories.headline: Israel kills Hamas security chief in Gaza strike

stories.body: The treaty bars any foreign military or security base on Solomon Islands and deepens Canberra's Pacific role.
stories.headline: Australia and Solomons sign no-base treaty

stories.body: Shenzhou-24 docks with Tiangong about 3.5 hours after launch, carrying Pakistan's first astronaut.
stories.headline: Shenzhou-24 docks; Pakistan's first astronaut in orbit

tagline: The world's news in one image
